title: Maajaayi hai Zainab dukh paayi hai Zainab
body:
Maajaayi hai Zainab dukh paayi hai Zainab
Aye laasha-e-beysar tera sar laayi hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar nangay thi mein zauja-e-haakim joonhi aayi
Zindaan mein kya Hind sey sharmaayi hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaidi bani sar nangay phiree dum nahin maara
Sab aapka farmaan bajaa laayi hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Marthay huvey tum jisko mujhey soump gaye thay
Us laadli ko shaam mein kho aayi hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaalim ney chardee maari labboun par jo tumhaarey
Khamoosh khadi ghaiz mein thar-raayi hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab saath mujhey qabr mein leylijiyo bhaayi
Duniyaa kay bahoth ranj sey ghabraayi hai Zainab
